d:
Located around 60–65 km from Ranchi, McCluskieganj welcomes travellers with forest-lined roads, quiet surroundings and a landscape shaped by nature and history. The drive from Ranchi gradually opens into a serene destination where the journey itself becomes part of the experience.
Known for its distinctive Anglo-Indian heritage, McCluskieganj preserves an important chapter of its past through old bungalows, colonial-era architectural influences and the cultural legacy of the community that once made this region its home.
